title: Board: show an item's history in its detail
notes: Smallest next step: a board route that returns show --history --json for one key, drawn as a collapsed History section of the detail.
result: The item detail has a folded History section with the entries of tadu show --history, fetched from the token-protected /api/history only when opened
evidence: pytest: 1218 tests at 100% coverage, among them tests/test_board_history.py, test_board_history_server.py and test_board_history_js.py (the board's rows equal show --history's lines); a jsdom run against a live tadu board: one fetch on first open, none on reopen, refetch after Reload, an error for a checkout outside git
